reviews.title: Linear review.
reviews.pros:
Started using linear recently, really flexible software.

Initially thought it was mostly for code work, but can extend to just about any project you would like to get started with.
reviews.cons: Lack of sharing capabilities externally is quite a problem, did a document on the platform and was unable to share it externally.
reviews.overall: Linear is still early, really flexible as we are currently using it as a project management software. I think the main intention of the platform is for code projects but, it has Asana-like capabilities with creating projects.
